data.gender_notes: Manto is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manto is derived from the Sanskrit word 'manas' meaning mind, and 'tam' meaning protected. It is also associated with mountains and mantles, signifying strength, protection, and wisdom. The name Manto carries the meaning “Mantle, Mountain” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Manto usually hope their child will grow to embody mantle, mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine protection and guidance of the god within.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manto total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
